get_models: fetch the list of supported ML models from the OCP API using the async Client
get_bulks: fetch the list of supported bulk materials from the OCP API using the async Client
get_slabs: get a unique list of surface slabs for a given bulk material via the OCP API Client
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: submit adsorbate configurations for relaxation on a slab using a specified ML model via the OCP API Client
get_adsorbate_slab_relaxations_results: fetch relaxation results for a submitted system by its ID using the OCP API Client
